description: Verify a multi-chain ERC-20 stablecoin transfer (USDT or USDC across Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, or Ethereum) sent to the job's unique BIP-44 watch-only deposit_address and unlock the fabrication bundle. Use this tool when paying via stablecoin_payment_instructions across any supported EVM chain or USDT (whereas calligraphy_verify_crypto_payment is exclusively for x402 Base Mainnet USDC transfers to the treasury wallet). Requires job_id and a 0x-prefixed 66-character tx_hash, plus optional token and network. Returns JSON with unlocked=True, payment_rail, and download_token; if verification fails, check network, token, and exact atomic amount.

job_id.description: Target compilation job identifier awaiting payment unlock. Example: 'job_01'.

network.description: EVM network where the transaction was mined: 'base' (Chain ID 8453), 'arbitrum' (42161), 'polygon' (137), or 'ethereum' (1).

token.description: ERC-20 stablecoin symbol transferred ('USDC' or 'USDT', 6 decimals).

tx_hash.description: 0x-prefixed 66-character hexadecimal EVM transaction hash of the confirmed ERC-20 Transfer event. Example: '0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111'.

name: calligraphy_verify_stablecoin_payment
title: Verify On-Chain Stablecoin Payment
